features.feature: NoZoom / NoRotate preserve the annotation upper-left Rect corner while adjusting the other corners in screen space
features.source_location: Physical486/printed471 Table167; following prose and Figure78 physical487/printed472.
features.source_rule: NoZoom keeps apparent size independent of page magnification. NoRotate keeps the appearance's orientation when the page rotates through the page object's /Rotate. In either case the upper-left corner of /Rect remains fixed in default user space; the processor performs the transform without changing /Rect.
features.errata: No relevant EC3 annotation found for this rule. Issue #422, elsewhere in §12.5.5's checkbox example, is typographic and does not alter this geometry.
features.code: annotation.rs::ViewGeometry::adjustment composes around min-x/max-y of Rect; content/annotations.rs supplies Page.rotate and screen magnification (Print supplies None); adjustment is composed onto the entire annotation before page base transform.
existing_assertions: a_no_rotate_annotation_pivots_about_its_own_corner: /Rotate 90, off-origin Rect [40 40 70 70], asymmetric AP; asserts on/off pixels and literal extent
a_no_zoom_annotation_keeps_its_size_when_the_page_is_magnified: zoom 2, 0.5 and unstated scale, literal extent; unflagged Square control
features.verdict: The separate NoZoom and NoRotate behaviors are already meaningfully tested. I found a narrower combination gap: the public pixel tests do not combine both flags with a non-identity AP Matrix and off-origin BBox. The prose expressly requires any whole-annotation transform to apply to its appearance, so this is a useful composition regression, not evidence of a current behavior failure.
features.residuals: No separate arbitrary viewer-rotation API was found in this path; this implementation takes page.rotate from the in-file /Rotate. The normative trigger quoted here is page rotation by changing /Rotate, not a host-only screen rotation. This review does not certify every annotation subtype's flag override or print behavior.

features.feature: Transform appearance BBox through AP Matrix, align the transformed box to Rect, then apply whole-annotation NoZoom/NoRotate adjustment
features.source_location: Physical489/printed474, appearance mapping algorithm and whole-annotation transform paragraph.
features.source_rule: Steps 1–3 transform BBox with Matrix, compute A to align that transformed extent to Rect, and concatenate Matrix with A. The next paragraph says the annotation may be further scaled/rotated for NoZoom/NoRotate and that any transform applied to the annotation as a whole shall be applied to the appearance within it.
features.errata: No relevant EC3 correction to the mapping algorithm located. Issue #422 affects italicization in an example, not this rule.
features.ledger: 12.5.5 departed only for its recorded BM/ca/CA transparency interpretation; placement is explicitly implemented and named by annotations.rs tests.
features.code: appearance.rs::placement computes transformed appearance extent and alignment; content/annotations.rs::draw_annotation composes adjust.transform before the page base transform; annotation.rs::decide supplies whole-annotation adjustment.
features.verdict: The existing tests separately establish AP Matrix/BBox placement and each view flag, but do not establish their composition in one rendered annotation. The draft adds that missing orthogonal combination with literal affine geometry.
features.residuals: Draft has not been compiled or executed by this agent; parent should verify fixture validity, exact alpha extents, and no-recovery assertion. It intentionally does not claim a NoZoom defect.
